scientific_integrity: Exact proofs are model-conditional; the all-size theorem is not inferred from finite computations. The source comparison is a same mathematical model literature review, not an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Independent infection indicators and perfectly accurate assays; all positive pools have all persons retested.
Identical fixed pool sizes and no assay dilution or correlated status; no claim about choosing pool sizes or adaptive algorithms.
Full comparison with the 2026 positive-assortative-matching article is limited by unavailability of its complete text; independent bibliographic audit is pending.
title: Stochastic-dominance optimality of ordered fixed-size Dorfman pools and a variance reversal
